name: University of Auckland
description: The University of Auckland is a public research university in Auckland, founded in 1883. With over 40,000 students it is New Zealand's largest university.
whyIncluded: Its MB ChB is on the Singapore Medical Council's list of registrable basic medical qualifications and its LLB is on the Singapore Institute of Legal Education's list of approved overseas universities (graduates in the top 70% of their cohort).

livingCosts.summary: Living costs listed by the university's Business School for a 12-month year: rent, groceries, a bus pass, phone and gym. Entertainment is not included.
livingCosts.notes: University of Auckland Business School 'Living costs' list (the main auckland.ac.nz cost-of-living page gives no full estimate; the page gives no year, 2026 is the year it was read), range midpoints. Housing: rent $200-$300/wk x 52/12. Food: groceries $100-$150/wk x 52/12. Transport: monthly bus pass $200-$250. Personal: phone plan $30-$40/month + gym membership $319/yr / 12; excludes entertainment (the university's accommodation page suggests ~$70/wk for entertainment and gym). The page's headline is NZ$20,000-$25,000 a year (NZ$400-$450/wk) for accommodation, food and transport.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Arts
programmes.summary: Estimated yearly tuition for international students, for a full-time year. Performance and science-based courses cost more. Student services fee included. Not fixed.
programmes.notes: 2026 estimated international fee for 120 points, excluding performance and science-based courses (those NZ$48,133). Compulsory = Student Services Fee NZ$9.44/point x 120 (cssf page). 2024/2025 = 8 x 15-point Arts course fee from that year's international Arts fee schedule, with SSF NZ$8.88 / NZ$9.24 per point.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Laws
programmes.summary: Estimated yearly tuition for international students for a full-time year of law; the first year is a little lower. Student services fee included. Not fixed.
programmes.notes: 2026 estimated international fee for 120 points (8 x 15-point LAW course at NZ$5,902.20; 480 points over 4 years). LLB Part I is 45 points of law plus 75 points from another degree, so the first year is a little lower. Compulsory = Student Services Fee NZ$9.44/point x 120 (cssf page). 2024/2025 = 8 x 15-point LAW course fee from that year's international Law fee schedule, with SSF NZ$8.88 / NZ$9.24 per point.

programmes.name: Master of Laws
programmes.summary: Tuition for international students for this one-year master's. Student services fee included.
programmes.notes: 2026 international fee for 120 points of 700-level LAW courses (8 x 15-point LAW 760 at NZ$6,074.40, or 4 x 30-point LAW 701 at NZ$12,148.80); taught or research LLM, 1 year. Compulsory = Student Services Fee NZ$9.44/point x 120. 2024/2025 = 8 x 15-point 700-level LAW course fee from that year's schedule, with SSF NZ$8.88 / NZ$9.24 per point.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MB ChB)
programmes.summary: First-year fee only. Years 2 to 6 cost about NZ$86,561 a year, so the six-year total is about NZ$475,600. Student services fee included.
programmes.notes: First-year rate: the 2026 estimated international fee for the Year 1 (overlapping BHSc / Biomedical Science year, 120 points at NZ$5,352.30 per 15-point course), which the programme list quotes for MB ChB Year 1. Years 2 to 6 are NZ$86,561 a year (MBChB Part II-VI, 2 x 60-point halves at NZ$43,280.40 each; Part III is 105 points, NZ$75,740.70), so the six-year total is about NZ$475,600. 720 points over 6 years. Compulsory = Student Services Fee NZ$9.44/point x 120. 2024/2025 = 8 x 15-point Year 1 course fee (MEDSCI 142 / POPLHLTH) from that year's international Medical and Health Sciences schedule, with SSF NZ$8.88 / NZ$9.24 per point; MBChB Part II was NZ$83,232 in 2024 and NZ$86,560.80 in 2025.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Commerce
programmes.summary: Estimated yearly tuition for international students, including 15% GST and the student services fee. Books, insurance and living costs are extra. Not fixed.
programmes.notes: 2026 indicative international fee for 120 points from the programme page's Fees section (8 x 15-point Business School course at NZ$6,016.65, e.g. BUSINESS 111; 360 points over 3 years); inclusive of 15% GST, excludes books, insurance and living costs. Compulsory = Student Services Fee NZ$9.44/point x 120 (cssf page). 2025 = 8 x 15-point BUSINESS 111 fee from the 2025 international Business and Economics fee schedule, with SSF NZ$9.24 per point; no 2024 Business and Economics schedule is published.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Engineering (Honours)
programmes.summary: Estimated yearly tuition for international students, including 15% GST and the student services fee. Books, insurance and living costs are extra. Not fixed.
programmes.notes: 2026 indicative international fee for 120 points from the programme page's Fees section (8 x 15-point Part I engineering course at NZ$7,251.15, e.g. ENGGEN 115; 480 points over 4 years); inclusive of 15% GST, excludes books, insurance and living costs. Compulsory = Student Services Fee NZ$9.44/point x 120 (cssf page). 2024/2025 = 8 x 15-point ENGGEN 115 fee from that year's international Engineering fee schedule, with SSF NZ$8.88 / NZ$9.24 per point.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science
programmes.summary: Lower end of the published range for international students; laboratory-heavy majors cost more. Includes 15% GST and the student services fee. Books and insurance are extra.
programmes.notes: Lower end of the 2026 indicative international range NZ$47,221 - $58,009 on the programme page's Fees section: 8 x 15-point standard Science course at NZ$5,902.65 (e.g. BIOSCI 101, CHEM 110, COMPSCI 101; laboratory-heavy majors cost more); 360 points over 3 years; inclusive of 15% GST, excludes books, insurance and living costs. The Computer Science major is the same degree at the same fee, so it is not recorded separately. Compulsory = Student Services Fee NZ$9.44/point x 120 (cssf page). 2024/2025 = 8 x 15-point BIOSCI 101 / COMPSCI 101 fee from that year's international Science fee schedule, with SSF NZ$8.88 / NZ$9.24 per point.

programmes.name: Master of Arts
programmes.summary: Tuition for international students for the one-year taught master's, including 15% GST and the student services fee. Fees vary by subject.
programmes.notes: 2026 international fee for 120 points of 700-level Arts courses (8 x 15-point course at NZ$5,621.25, e.g. ARTSGEN 740 / HISTORY 700A) from the 2026 international Arts and Education fee schedule; taught 120-point MA, 1 year (the programme page quotes NZ$43,674 - $55,484 across all subjects). Inclusive of 15% GST. Compulsory = Student Services Fee NZ$9.44/point x 120 (cssf page). 2024/2025 = 8 x 15-point 700-level Arts course fee from that year's international Arts fee schedule, with SSF NZ$8.88 / NZ$9.24 per point.

programmes.name: Master of Business Administration
programmes.summary: Annual share of the 18-month MBA total for international students, including 15% GST and the student services fee. Travel for intensives and the study tour is extra.
programmes.notes: 180-point MBA over 18 months (6 quarters of 30 points): 2026 international fee NZ$7,536.00 per 15-point BUSMBA course from the 2026 international Business and Economics fee schedule, so NZ$90,432 for the programme; recorded per year as 8 x 15 points (120 points). The programme page only publishes the domestic fee (NZ$51,898 for 180 points). Inclusive of 15% GST; travel for intensives and the study tour is extra. Compulsory = Student Services Fee NZ$9.44/point x 120 (cssf page). 2025 = 8 x 15-point BUSMBA course fee (NZ$7,177.20) from the 2025 schedule, with SSF NZ$9.24 per point; no 2024 Business and Economics schedule is published.

programmes.name: Master of Information Technology
programmes.summary: Estimated yearly tuition for international students in this 1.5-year programme with an industry internship. Includes 15% GST and the student services fee. Books and insurance extra.
programmes.notes: 2026 indicative international fee per year (120 points) from the programme page's Fees section; 180-point MInfoTech (1.5 years) for entry from a bachelor's degree, awarded jointly with the University of Waikato, including a 60-point industry internship; inclusive of 15% GST, excludes books, insurance and living costs. Compulsory = Student Services Fee NZ$9.44/point x 120 (cssf page). Earlier years' page figures are not published.

programmes.name: Master of Engineering Studies
programmes.summary: Tuition for international students for the one-year programme (1.5 years if you hold a 3-year degree). Includes 15% GST and the student services fee. Books and insurance extra.
programmes.notes: 2026 indicative international fee for 120 points from the programme page's Fees section (8 x 15-point 700-level engineering course at NZ$6,935.55, e.g. ENGGEN 701); taught 120-point MEngSt for holders of a 4-year BE(Hons), 1 year (180 points / 1.5 years from a 3-year degree); inclusive of 15% GST, excludes books, insurance and living costs. Compulsory = Student Services Fee NZ$9.44/point x 120 (cssf page). 2024/2025 = 8 x 15-point 700-level ENGGEN course fee from that year's international Engineering fee schedule, with SSF NZ$8.88 / NZ$9.24 per point.

programmes.name: Master of Science
programmes.summary: Estimated yearly tuition for international students in the 2-year master's (1 year after an honours degree). Includes 15% GST and the student services fee. Books and insurance extra.
programmes.notes: 2026 indicative international fee per year (120 points) from the programme page's Fees section (8 x 15-point 700-level Science course at NZ$6,935.55, e.g. BIOSCI 700 / COMPSCI 701); 240-point MSc over 2 years for direct entry from a bachelor's degree (120 points / 1 year after a BSc(Hons) or PGDipSci); inclusive of 15% GST, excludes books, insurance and living costs. Compulsory = Student Services Fee NZ$9.44/point x 120 (cssf page). 2024/2025 = 8 x 15-point 700-level Science course fee from that year's international Science fee schedule, with SSF NZ$8.88 / NZ$9.24 per point.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science (Psychology major)
programmes.summary: Yearly tuition for international students for 120 points of standard science courses, including 15% GST and the student services fee. Books and insurance are extra.
programmes.notes: Psychology is a major in the BSc (also the BA); the new Bachelor of Psychology (BPsych) takes its first students in 2027 and its page quotes the same 2026 international figure (NZ$47,221). 2026 figure = lower end of the BSc page's indicative international range NZ$47,221 - $58,009; PSYCH courses are standard Science courses (2026 international Science fee schedule: PSYCH 108 / PSYCH 109, 15 points, NZ$5,902.65 each; 8 x 15 points = NZ$47,221.20). 360 points over 3 years; inclusive of 15% GST. Compulsory = Student Services Fee NZ$9.44/point x 120 (cssf page). 2024/2025 = 8 x 15-point PSYCH 108/109 fee from that year's international Science fee schedule (NZ$5,405.40 / NZ$5,621.55), with SSF NZ$8.88 / NZ$9.24 per point.

programmes.name: Master of Science (Psychology)
programmes.summary: Estimated yearly tuition for international students in the 2-year master's (1 year after an honours degree). Includes 15% GST and the student services fee. Books and insurance extra.
programmes.notes: MSc specialisation in Psychology, 240 points over 2 years from a bachelor's degree (taught courses plus a thesis; 120 points / 1 year after honours). 2026 fee per year = 8 x 15-point 700-level PSYCH course at NZ$6,935.55 (e.g. PSYCH 714, PSYCH 723; 2026 international Science fee schedule) = NZ$55,484.40, the same as the Master of Science entry's figure from the programme page. Auckland's other taught option is the Master of Organisational Psychology. Inclusive of 15% GST. Compulsory = Student Services Fee NZ$9.44/point x 120 (cssf page). 2024/2025 = 8 x 15-point 700-level PSYCH course fee from that year's international Science fee schedule (NZ$6,351.15 / NZ$6,605.25), with SSF NZ$8.88 / NZ$9.24 per point.
